intro: Where the systems above come from.

entries.summary: I build and evolve the systems that institutional processes depend on: ERPs with over 50 modules, academic management systems, access control, and mobile applications published for Android and iOS. I worked in the technical coordination of development teams between January 2016 and July 2019, which included defining processes, standards, and criteria for reviewing code and documentation.
